description: Open a signed-in browser upload for film artwork, the title image (kind title: the film's title lettering as a PNG with a transparent background, shown in place of the text title on the film page and the Discover and homepage heroes; kind title_en: the same for the English title of a film written in another language, shown to visitors who see its English text), a season poster, the thumbnail of the trailer, of a season's trailer (season_id) or of an episode (episode_id) as a JPEG image, an uploaded subtitle, an existing bonus file/thumbnail, or (kind review_evidence) evidence of your rights for a film held for copyright: a licence, distribution agreement or listing in your name, PDF, JPG or PNG up to 10 MB, five files per hold. No arbitrary URL fetching. The upload uses the website's file validation and owner checks.

subtitle_kind.description: subtitles = full subtitles; captions = SDH; forced = only the lines a viewer needs with subtitles off (dialogue in another language, on-screen text), shown by the player on its own
